description: 多关键词命中：JWT 黑名单 + Redis 实现
user_input: JWT 黑名单是怎么用 Redis 实现的？

mock_retrieved_docs.content: JWT logout stores token jti in Redis blacklist with TTL matching token expiration. During authentication, the system checks if the jti exists in the blacklist before validating the token.

success_criteria: 检索结果同时包含 JWT、Redis、blacklist 三个关键词
notes: 验证多关键词同时命中
